newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian metals market closed for Hindu festival.
newsitem.headline: Indian metals market closed for Hindu festival.

text.p: The Bombay non-ferrous metals market was closed on Monday for Holi, the Hindu spring festival of colours. The market will reopen on Tuesday.
On Friday, copper rose by 50 rupees at 13,500 rupees per quintal while aluminium moved up by 25 rupees at 7,425 rupees per quintal. Tin lifted by 100 rupees at 37,600 rupees per quintal.
Nickel was steady at 37,300 rupees per quintal, zinc at 7,700 rupees and lead at 4,550 rupees per quintal amid limited activity.
